exposure: female sex of the last child born
outcome: discordance between measures of pregnancy intention
cohort: The study included 1200 women who had recently delivered a baby and were visiting hospitals for postnatal care in four randomly selected districts of Bangladesh.
finding: The prevalence of unintended pregnancy was higher when measured by the London Measure (31.0%) compared to the DHS measure (24.3%), with significant discordance (27.1%) associated with sociodemographic factors like age, wealth, and rural living.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in 2023 from women who had recently delivered a baby and were attending postnatal care.
